content:
我最近正在收聽一個Podcast，其中一集是關於「心盛」(flourishing)，這激發了我的好奇心。是否有任何具體的標準或指導性問題，可以指明一個人是否在其生命中處於豐盛狀態？

在搜尋資料後，發現其中一個最廣受歡迎的模型是 PERMA。以下是關於「心盛」的指南：

  • 「P」是正向情緒 (Positive Emotion)：您有多常對自己的生活感到滿意？
  • 「E」是全心投入 (Engagement)：您上一次完全專注於一項活動，以至於忘記時間，是什麼時候？
  • 「R」是正向關係 (Relationships)：您在生命中擁有良好的人際關係嗎？
  • 「M」是生命意義 (Meaning)：您是否正朝著您的目標邁進？
  • 「A」是成就感 (Accomplishment)：您是否享受您生命中的成就，例如在工作、興趣或照顧嬰兒？

透過評估這些指標，人們可以確定「豐盛」的程度；這種感受並非短暫的快樂，而應是在其整體的日常中，維持在高水平的滿意度。

「你感到心盛嗎？」

I was just listening to a podcast, and the episode is about “flourishing”, which sparked my curiosity. Are there any specific standards or guiding questions that would indicate whether a person is flourishing in their life?

After searching the data, one of the most popular models is PERMA. Below is the guide to “flourishing”:

  • “P” is Positive Emotion: How often have you felt satisfied with your life?
  • “E” is Engagement: What was the last time you felt fully concentrated on your activity, so much so that you forgot the time?
  • “R” is Relationships: Do you have great relationships in your life?
  • “M” is Meaning: Are you making progress toward your goals?
  • “A” is Accomplishment: Do you enjoy the accomplishments in your life, like work, interests, or taking care of a baby?

By evaluating these indicators, people can ascertain the degree of “flourishing”; the feeling is not happiness in a short moment, but it should remain at a high level of satisfaction in their overall day.

「Are you flourishing?」
